skill.description: Draft product image headlines, subtitles, selling points, and visual suggestions from supplied facts or supported Douyin and Xiaohongshu product data.
skill.summary: Create three evidence-based product image copy options with source notes and missing information.

security_audit.summary: One finding is confirmed because the online examples execute an unpinned npm package with automatic confirmation. The remaining 36 findings reflect Markdown formatting, ordinary credential documentation, service links, product identifiers, or readable Chinese text. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or concealed payloads in the supplied files; external package implementation was not included.

remediation.issue: Online examples execute socialdatax-skills@latest through npx -y, allowing downloaded package code to run without a stable reviewed version.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version, verify its provenance and integrity, and obtain user approval before first execution with credentials available.

content.value_statement: Product facts can be difficult to turn into concise image headlines without adding unsupported claims. This skill drafts structured copy options with visual suggestions and source notes.
actual_capabilities: Draft three copy options by default, each with a headline, subtitle, up to three selling points, and a visual suggestion.
Write directly from supplied product information without requiring an API key or online lookup.
Retrieve Douyin and Xiaohongshu product details through documented SocialDataX CLI commands or corresponding MCP tools when configured.
Reference up to three related products on request, using one search page and at most two additional detail checks.
Separate supported facts from suggested wording, record sources, and flag missing or conflicting product information.
Respect requested copy counts, length limits, audience, tone, platform, and image placement.
limitations: Produces text and visual suggestions, not generated images, edited assets, or published listings.
Online retrieval supports only Douyin and Xiaohongshu; other platforms require pasted product information.
Online CLI examples require Node.js, npm, and a SocialDataX API key; usage may require paid service credits.
Does not independently verify product claims or guarantee click-through improvements; CLI examples execute an unpinned external npm package.

use_cases.title: Prepare a new product listing
use_cases.description: Turn a verified specification sheet into three image-copy directions, each with concise selling points and a suggested product view.

use_cases.title: Brief a product photographer
use_cases.description: Pair each supported product benefit with a headline and a specific detail or usage scene to photograph.

use_cases.title: Compare messaging directions
use_cases.description: Use requested Douyin or Xiaohongshu references to explore copy structure without copying competitors or transferring their product claims.

prompt_templates.title: Start with supplied facts
prompt_templates.prompt: Use these facts: [product facts]. Draft three product image copy options with headlines, subtitles, selling points, and visual suggestions. Do not browse.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: draft copy without API setup.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt to a specific audience
prompt_templates.prompt: Use [verified product facts] for [audience] on [platform]. Draft three options in [tone]. Limit each headline to [length]. Flag missing evidence.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: tailor wording and layout constraints.

prompt_templates.title: Draft from a supported product link
prompt_templates.prompt: Retrieve this [Douyin or Xiaohongshu product link] using configured SocialDataX access. Draft three copy options. Include sources, query time, and unresolved facts.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: use configured online product retrieval.

prompt_templates.title: Use limited competitor references
prompt_templates.prompt: Use [supported product link] and reference up to three related products on its platform. Check at most two reference details. Draft distinct, fact-supported options.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: compare messaging structures within explicit lookup limits.

output_examples.input: User-supplied facts: a 500 ml stainless steel bottle with a carry loop. Draft one option without browsing.
output: Subtitle: A 500 ml bottle with a carry loop.
Selling points: 500 ml capacity; stainless steel body; carry loop.
Visual suggestion: show the bottle upright with the loop clearly visible.
Source: user-provided facts. Missing information: insulation performance and leak resistance.

output_examples.input: User-supplied facts: a storage box measuring 30 x 20 x 15 cm with a removable divider. Draft one option for desk organization.
output: Subtitle: Organize desk items with a removable divider.
Selling points: removable divider; 30 x 20 x 15 cm dimensions.
Visual suggestion: show the open box with the divider beside it and dimensions labeled.
Source: user-provided facts. Missing information: material, load capacity, and available colors.

best_practices: Provide verified specifications, audience, platform, tone, and headline length before requesting copy.
Use supplied facts when sufficient; authorize online lookups and review the external CLI package before execution.
Check every claim, current price, promotion condition, and source note before publishing.
anti_patterns: Adding unsupported certifications, performance figures, medical benefits, or claims of market leadership.
Copying competitor wording or presenting competitor specifications as facts about the target product.
Requesting image generation, unsupported-platform retrieval, or automatic listing publication from this text-focused workflow.

faq.question: Do I need an API key?
faq.answer: No key is required for supplied product facts. Online product retrieval requires a configured SocialDataX API key.

faq.question: Which product links are supported?
faq.answer: Online retrieval supports Douyin and Xiaohongshu product links or identifiers. Paste product facts for other platforms.

faq.question: What does each copy option contain?
faq.answer: Each option contains a headline, subtitle, up to three selling points, and a visual suggestion. The default is three options.

faq.question: Does the skill create or publish images?
faq.answer: No. It produces copy and visual suggestions without generating images, publishing listings, or modifying accounts.

faq.question: Can it use competitor references?
faq.answer: Yes, on explicit request. It references up to three related products and uses their structure, not their wording or unsupported claims.

faq.question: What should I know before using online retrieval?
faq.answer: The CLI examples execute an external npm package at latest. Review and pin the package first; SocialDataX calls may require credits.
